meta.description: Full-service classic car restoration, muscle car engine builds, body repair, and rare parts in Fort Worth, TX. Call 682-285-1221.

props.title: Classic muscle car restoration at
props.subtitle: From total frame-off vehicle overhauls and high-performance engine tuning to get-it-running driver builds, we bring automotive legends back to life.

props.title: Built with passion, engineered for performance
props.subtitle: We treat every vintage muscle car, truck, and survivor chassis with obsessive attention to historical detail and mechanical precision.

items.title: Complete Frame-Off Builds
items.text: Full disassembly, rust remediation, sandblasting, powder coating, and precision reassembly with modern reliability.

items.title: High-Output Engine & Drivetrain
items.text: V8 crate engine swaps, carburetor tuning, transmission upgrades, performance suspension, and modern disc brake conversions.

items.title: Straightforward Process
items.text: Regular photographic build logs and transparent billing so you are always connected to the progress of your vehicle.

items.title: Sale Cars & Rare Parts
items.text: Curated selection of classic muscle cars ready for purchase, alongside hard-to-find vintage OEM parts.

props.title: Tailored builds for collectors & enthusiasts
props.description: Whether you want a turnkey show-winner or a dependable weekend cruiser, our Fort Worth facility handles it all.

services.title: Full Custom Restoration
services.text: Complete nut-and-bolt restoration from bare metal to concourse paint finish and custom upholstery.

services.title: Driver Refresh & Mechanicals
services.text: Fuel system flush, electrical rewiring, cooling overhaul, and engine revival to get barn finds safely on the road.

services.title: Brakes, Suspension & Handling
services.text: Tubular A-arms, coilover conversion, rack-and-pinion steering, and multi-piston power brake setups.

services.title: Vehicle Consignment & Sourcing
services.text: Professional valuation, marketing, and acquisition of authentic muscle cars across Texas and the US.
